1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""V2 Checkpoint Same-Seed Gradient Analysis for OccSafe-VLA.
3	
4	Compares gradient flow patterns across v2 checkpoints to determine if
5	training dynamics match v1 D042 findings ("existence regularization").
6	
7	Metrics computed on _cached_patch_features (shared visual representation):
8	  1. Action gradient norm (CE loss -> LLM -> projector -> patch_features)
9	  2. OCC gradient norm (focal loss -> OCC head -> patch_features)
10	  3. Cosine similarity between action and OCC gradients
11	  4. Conflict rate (fraction of dims where gradients disagree in sign)
12	  5. DINOv2 vs SigLIP action gradient ratio (split by feature dimension)
13	"""

78	def create_batch(processor, device, seed):
79	    """Create synthetic batch matching training data format."""
80	    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
81	    B = BATCH_SIZE
82	
83	    pixel_values = torch.randn(B, 6, 224, 224, generator=g, dtype=torch.bfloat16).to(device)
84	
85	    prompt = ("In: What action should the robot take to pick up the red block "
86	              "and place it on the table?\n")
87	    enc = processor.tokenizer(prompt, return_tensors="pt", padding=False)
88	    prompt_ids = enc.input_ids
89	    prompt_len = prompt_ids.shape[1]
90	
91	    n_act = NUM_ACTIONS_CHUNK * ACTION_DIM  # 56
92	    act_ids = torch.randint(
93	        ACTION_TOKEN_BEGIN_IDX, ACTION_TOKEN_BEGIN_IDX + 256,
94	        (B, n_act), generator=g
95	    )
96	
97	    input_ids = torch.cat([prompt_ids.expand(B, -1), act_ids], dim=1).to(device)
98	    attention_mask = torch.ones_like(input_ids)
99	
100	    labels = torch.full_like(input_ids, IGNORE_INDEX)
101	    labels[:, prompt_len:] = act_ids.to(device)
102	
103	    occ_labels = (torch.rand(B, 64, 64, generator=g) > 0.85).float().to(device)
104	
105	    return {
106	        "input_ids": input_ids,
107	        "attention_mask": attention_mask,
108	        "pixel_values": pixel_values,
109	        "labels": labels,
110	        "occ_labels": occ_labels,
111	    }
112	
113	
114	def analyze_one(name, info):
115	    """Run gradient analysis on a single checkpoint."""
116	    print(f"\n{'='*60}\nAnalyzing: {name}\n{'='*60}")
117	    path = info["path"]
118	    has_occ = info["has_occ"]
119	    occ_detach = info["occ_detach"]
120	
121	    # Load model (merged LoRA checkpoint)
122	    print(f"Loading model...")
123	    model = AutoModelForVision2Seq.from_pretrained(
124	        path, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, low_cpu_mem_usage=True, trust_remote_code=True
125	    ).to(DEVICE).eval()
126	
127	    processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(path, trust_remote_code=True)
128	
129	    # Vision backbone dimensions
130	    dino_dim = model.vision_backbone.featurizer.embed_dim
131	    siglip_dim = (model.vision_backbone.fused_featurizer.embed_dim
132	                  if model.vision_backbone.use_fused_vision_backbone else 0)
133	    total_dim = dino_dim + siglip_dim
134	    print(f"Vision dims: DINOv2={dino_dim}, SigLIP={siglip_dim}, total={total_dim}")
135	
136	    # Load OCC head
137	    occ_head, occ_fn = None, None
138	    if has_occ:
139	        occ_head = BEVOccupancyHead(in_dim=total_dim)
140	        sd = torch.load(
141	            os.path.join(path, "occ_head--50000_checkpoint.pt"),
142	            map_location="cpu", weights_only=True
143	        )
144	        occ_head.load_state_dict({k.replace("module.", ""): v for k, v in sd.items()})
145	        occ_head = occ_head.to(torch.bfloat16).to(DEVICE).eval()
146	        occ_fn = FocalLoss()
147	        print("OCC head loaded")
148	
149	    # Monkey-patch _process_vision_features to capture patch_features with grad
150	    pf_ref = [None]
151	
152	    def patched_process(self, pixel_values, language_embeddings=None, use_film=False):
153	        if use_film:
154	            pf = self.vision_backbone(pixel_values, language_embeddings)
155	        else:
156	            pf = self.vision_backbone(pixel_values)
157	        # Detach from frozen backbone, enable grad for analysis
158	        pf = pf.detach().requires_grad_(True)
159	        self._cached_patch_features = pf
160	        pf_ref[0] = pf
161	        return self.projector(pf)
162	
163	    model._process_vision_features = types.MethodType(patched_process, model)
164	
165	    # Enable grad on projector params (for projector gradient analysis)
166	    for p in model.projector.parameters():
167	        p.requires_grad_(True)
168	
169	    # Collect per-batch metrics
170	    metrics = {k: [] for k in [
171	        "action_grad_norm", "occ_grad_norm", "cosine_sim", "conflict_rate",
172	        "dino_grad_norm", "siglip_grad_norm", "proj_action_grad_norm",
173	    ]}
174	
175	    for batch_idx in range(NUM_BATCHES):
176	        batch = create_batch(processor, DEVICE, SEED + batch_idx)
177	        model.zero_grad()
178	        if occ_head is not None:
179	            occ_head.zero_grad()
180	
181	        # Forward pass -> CE loss on action tokens
182	        output = model(
183	            input_ids=batch["input_ids"],
184	            attention_mask=batch["attention_mask"],
185	            pixel_values=batch["pixel_values"],
186	            labels=batch["labels"],
187	        )
188	
189	        pf = pf_ref[0]
190	        action_loss = output.loss
191	        proj_params = list(model.projector.parameters())
192	
193	        # Compute action gradient on patch_features + projector
194	        grads = torch.autograd.grad(
195	            action_loss, [pf] + proj_params,
196	            retain_graph=has_occ,
197	            allow_unused=True,
198	        )
199	
200	        ag = grads[0].float()  # Action gradient on patch_features
201	
202	        metrics["action_grad_norm"].append(ag.norm().item())
203	        metrics["dino_grad_norm"].append(ag[:, :, :dino_dim].norm().item())
204	        metrics["siglip_grad_norm"].append(ag[:, :, dino_dim:].norm().item())
205	        metrics["proj_action_grad_norm"].append(
206	            sum(g.float().norm().item()**2 for g in grads[1:] if g is not None)**0.5
207	        )
208	
209	        # OCC gradient on patch_features
210	        if has_occ:
211	            # For detach: compute OCC grad on a detached copy
212	            # For full_occ: compute OCC grad on the same pf (still connected to action graph)
213	            if occ_detach:
214	                occ_in = pf.detach().requires_grad_(True)
215	            else:
216	                occ_in = pf
217	
218	            occ_logits = occ_head(occ_in)
219	            occ_loss = occ_fn(occ_logits.float(), batch["occ_labels"])
220	
221	            og = torch.autograd.grad(occ_loss, [occ_in], allow_unused=True)[0].float()
222	
223	            metrics["occ_grad_norm"].append(og.norm().item())
224	
225	            a_flat = ag.flatten()
226	            o_flat = og.flatten()
227	            cos = F.cosine_similarity(a_flat.unsqueeze(0), o_flat.unsqueeze(0)).item()
228	            conf = (a_flat * o_flat < 0).float().mean().item()
229	            metrics["cosine_sim"].append(cos)
230	            metrics["conflict_rate"].append(conf)
231	
232	            print(f"  Batch {batch_idx}: action={metrics['action_grad_norm'][-1]:.6f} "
233	                  f"occ={og.norm().item():.6f} cos={cos:.4f} conflict={conf:.4f}")
234	        else:
235	            print(f"  Batch {batch_idx}: action={metrics['action_grad_norm'][-1]:.6f} "
236	                  f"dino={metrics['dino_grad_norm'][-1]:.6f} siglip={metrics['siglip_grad_norm'][-1]:.6f}")
237	
238	    # Aggregate results
239	    result = {
240	        "name": name,
241	        "has_occ": has_occ,
242	        "occ_detach": occ_detach,
243	        "checkpoint_path": path,
244	        "action_grad_norm": {
245	            "mean": float(np.mean(metrics["action_grad_norm"])),
246	            "std": float(np.std(metrics["action_grad_norm"])),
247	            "values": [float(v) for v in metrics["action_grad_norm"]],
248	        },
249	        "dino_action_grad_norm": {
250	            "mean": float(np.mean(metrics["dino_grad_norm"])),
251	            "std": float(np.std(metrics["dino_grad_norm"])),
252	        },
253	        "siglip_action_grad_norm": {
254	            "mean": float(np.mean(metrics["siglip_grad_norm"])),
255	            "std": float(np.std(metrics["siglip_grad_norm"])),
256	        },
257	        "dino_siglip_ratio": float(
258	            np.mean(metrics["dino_grad_norm"]) /
259	            max(np.mean(metrics["siglip_grad_norm"]), 1e-10)
260	        ),
261	        "projector_action_grad_norm": {
262	            "mean": float(np.mean(metrics["proj_action_grad_norm"])),
263	            "std": float(np.std(metrics["proj_action_grad_norm"])),
264	        },
265	    }
266	
267	    if has_occ:

271	                "std": float(np.std(metrics["occ_grad_norm"])),
272	                "values": [float(v) for v in metrics["occ_grad_norm"]],

289

300	def main():
301	    print(f"V2 Gradient Analysis | Device: {DEVICE} | Seed: {SEED} | Batches: {NUM_BATCHES}")
302	    print(f"Constants: ACTION_DIM={ACTION_DIM}, NUM_ACTIONS_CHUNK={NUM_ACTIONS_CHUNK}")
303

305	        dev_idx = int(DEVICE.split(":")[-1])

307	        print(f"GPU {dev_idx}: {free/1024**3:.1f}GB free / {total/1024**3:.1f}GB total")
308	
309	    results = {}
310	    for name, info in CHECKPOINTS.items():
311	        try:
312	            results[name] = analyze_one(name, info)
313	        except Exception as e:
314	            import traceback
315	            traceback.print_exc()
316	            results[name] = {"error": str(e)}

318	            gc.collect()

93	def get_layer_groups(model):
94	    """Group vision backbone parameters by encoder block."""
95	    groups = OrderedDict()
96	    for name, param in model.vision_backbone.named_parameters():
97	        parts = name.split(".")
98	        if "blocks" in parts:
99	            idx = parts.index("blocks")
100	            group = ".".join(parts[:idx + 2])
101	        else:
102	            prefix = parts[0] if parts[0] in ("featurizer", "fused_featurizer") else "other"
103	            group = prefix + ".stem"
104	        if group not in groups:
105	            groups[group] = []
106	        groups[group].append(param)
107	    return groups
108	
109	
110	def compute_per_layer_grads(grads, layer_groups):
111	    """Compute L2 norm and flattened gradient vector per layer group."""
112	    norms = {}
113	    vectors = {}
114	    idx = 0
115	    for group_name, params in layer_groups.items():
116	        parts = []
117	        for _ in params:
118	            g = grads[idx]
119	            if g is not None:
120	                parts.append(g.flatten().float())
121	            idx += 1
122	        if parts:
123	            vec = torch.cat(parts)
124	            norms[group_name] = vec.norm().item()
125	            vectors[group_name] = vec
126	        else:
127	            norms[group_name] = 0.0
128	            vectors[group_name] = None
129	    return norms, vectors
130	
131	
132	def extract_bn_stats(occ_head):
133	    """Extract BatchNorm running statistics from the occ head.
134	
135	    Returns dict with layer_name -> {running_mean, running_var, num_batches_tracked}.
136	    Only applicable when occ_head uses BatchNorm2d (norm_type='bn').
137	    """
138	    bn_stats = {}
139	    for name, module in occ_head.named_modules():
140	        if isinstance(module, nn.BatchNorm2d):
141	            bn_stats[name] = {
142	                "running_mean": module.running_mean.cpu().tolist(),
143	                "running_var": module.running_var.cpu().tolist(),
144	                "num_batches_tracked": module.num_batches_tracked.item(),
145	                "weight": module.weight.data.cpu().tolist(),
146	                "bias": module.bias.data.cpu().tolist(),
147	                "mean_drift_l2": module.running_mean.float().norm().item(),
148	                "var_drift_from_one_l2": (module.running_var.float() - 1.0).norm().item(),
149	            }
150	    return bn_stats

215	        sd = {k.replace("module.", ""): v for k, v in sd.items()}
216	        occ_head.load_state_dict(sd)

261	    )

271	
272	    # ---- Storage ----
273	    all_action_norms = {g: [] for g in layer_names}
274	    all_occ_norms = {g: [] for g in layer_names}
275	    all_cosine = {g: [] for g in layer_names}

286	        try:

322	            # ---- Action gradients ----

355	                    cosines[g] = float("nan")

357	            # ---- Record ----

361	                "occ_loss": occ_loss.item(),

363	            for g in layer_names:

368	            if batch_idx % 10 == 0:

380	
381	    total_batches = len(batch_stats)

401	    for g in layer_names:

403	        on = all_occ_norms[g]
404	        cs = [c for c in all_cosine[g] if not np.isnan(c)]

## Summary: Gradient Analysis v2 in OccSafe-VLA Project

Based on my thorough exploration of the project, here's what I found:

### 1. **Exact Output Format of Gradient Analysis (.pt and .json files)**

The project uses **JSON output** (no .pt files found for gradient analysis outputs). The structure from `v2_gradient_analysis.json` shows:

**Top-level keys per condition:**
- `name` - condition identifier
- `has_occ` - boolean
- `occ_detach` - boolean 
- `checkpoint_path` - full model path

**Metric keys:**
- `action_grad_norm` - object with `mean`, `std`, `values` (per-batch)
- `dino_action_grad_norm` - DINOv2 encoder specific (mean, std)
- `siglip_action_grad_norm` - SigLIP encoder specific (mean, std)
- `dino_siglip_ratio` - float ratio
- `projector_action_grad_norm` - (mean, std)
- `occ_grad_norm` - object with `mean`, `std`, `values` (when has_occ=true)
- `cosine_similarity` - action vs OCC grad alignment (mean, std, values)
- `conflict_rate` - fraction where gradients disagree in sign (mean, std, values)
- `occ_to_action_ratio` - float ratio

**Per-layer output structure** (from `same_seed_gradient_analysis.py`):
Each condition outputs two JSON files:
- `{condition_name}_gradient_stats.json` - aggregated summary with per_layer statistics
- `{condition_name}_gradient_raw.json` - raw batch-by-batch data

Per-layer dict structure:

    parser.add_argument("--dpi", type=int, default=300)
    return parser.parse_args()


def load_results(args):
    if args.files:
        paths = [Path(f) for f in args.files]
    elif args.results_dir:
        paths = sorted(Path(args.results_dir).glob("*_gradient_stats.json"))
    else:
        raise ValueError("Must specify --results_dir or --files")

    results = {}
    for p in paths:
        with open(p) as f:
            data = json.load(f)
        cond = data["condition"]
        results[cond] = data
        print(f"Loaded {cond}: {p.name}")
    return results


def extract_blocks(per_layer, prefix):
    blocks = []
    for layer_name, stats in per_layer.items():
        if layer_name.startswith(f"{prefix}.blocks."):
            idx = int(layer_name.split(".")[-1])
            blocks.append((idx, stats))
    blocks.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Per-layer action gradient norm heatmap (4 conditions × 2 encoders).

Narrative intent: Vanilla/Full OCC/Random OCC maintain comparable gradient
norms (warm), while Detach BN collapses to 1-13% across all layers (cold).
This directly supports the gradient collapse prevention mechanism (C1).
"""

import csv
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 12,
    'axes.labelsize': 11,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 9.5,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).parent
CSV_PATH = SCRIPT_DIR / 'per_layer_conflict_rate_full.csv'
OUT_DIR = Path('/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513/projects/occsafe_vla/docs/paper/figures')

CONDITIONS = ['Vanilla_s0', 'Full_OCC_s0', 'Random_s2', 'Detach_BN_s2']
COND_LABELS = ['Vanilla', 'Full OCC', 'Random OCC', 'Detach']
N_DINO = 23
N_SIGLIP = 26

# --- Load data ---
data = {}
with open(CSV_PATH) as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        cond = row['condition']
        enc = row['encoder']
        idx = int(row['layer_idx'])
        norm = float(row['action_grad_norm'])
        key = (cond, enc)
        if key not in data:
            data[key] = {}
        data[key][idx] = norm

# Build matrices
dino_matrix = np.zeros((len(CONDITIONS), N_DINO))
siglip_matrix = np.zeros((len(CONDITIONS), N_SIGLIP))

for ci, cond in enumerate(CONDITIONS):
    for li in range(N_DINO):
        dino_matrix[ci, li] = data[(cond, 'dino')].get(li, np.nan)
    for li in range(N_SIGLIP):
        siglip_matrix[ci, li] = data[(cond, 'siglip')].get(li, np.nan)

# --- Figure ---
fig, (ax_dino, ax_siglip) = plt.subplots(
    1, 2, figsize=(7.5, 2.2),
    gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [N_DINO, N_SIGLIP], 'wspace': 0.06},
    sharey=True
)

# Log scale normalization (shared across both panels)
vmin = min(dino_matrix.min(), siglip_matrix.min())
vmax = max(dino_matrix.max(), siglip_matrix.max())
norm = mcolors.LogNorm(vmin=max(vmin, 1e-4), vmax=vmax)

cmap = plt.cm.inferno.copy()

# DINOv2 panel
im_dino = ax_dino.imshow(
    dino_matrix, aspect='auto', cmap=cmap, norm=norm,
    interpolation='nearest'
)
ax_dino.set_xticks([0, 5, 10, 15, 22])
ax_dino.set_xticklabels(['0', '5', '10', '15', '22'])
ax_dino.set_yticks(range(len(COND_LABELS)))
ax_dino.set_yticklabels(COND_LABELS)
ax_dino.set_xlabel('DINOv2 block index')
ax_dino.set_title('(a) DINOv2', fontsize=11, pad=6)

# Separator line between gradient-flow conditions and Detach
ax_dino.axhline(2.5, color='white', linewidth=1.5, linestyle='-')

# SigLIP panel
im_siglip = ax_siglip.imshow(
    siglip_matrix, aspect='auto', cmap=cmap, norm=norm,
    interpolation='nearest'
)
ax_siglip.set_xticks([0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25])
ax_siglip.set_xticklabels(['0', '5', '10', '15', '20', '25'])
ax_siglip.set_xlabel('SigLIP block index')
ax_siglip.set_title('(b) SigLIP', fontsize=11, pad=6)
ax_siglip.yaxis.set_tick_params(labelleft=False)

ax_siglip.axhline(2.5, color='white', linewidth=1.5, linestyle='-')

# Collapse annotation on Detach row
t = ax_dino.text(
    11, 3, '1–13% of Vanilla',
    fontsize=8.5, color='#cccccc', ha='center', va='center',
    fontstyle='italic', fontweight='bold'
)
t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='#1a0a2e')])

t2 = ax_siglip.text(
    13, 3, '2–13% of Vanilla',
    fontsize=8.5, color='#cccccc', ha='center', va='center',
    fontstyle='italic', fontweight='bold'
)
t2.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='#1a0a2e')])

# Shared colorbar
cbar = fig.colorbar(im_siglip, ax=[ax_dino, ax_siglip],
                    location='right', fraction=0.02, pad=0.02,
                    label='Action gradient norm')

# Remove top/right spines (imshow adds them back)
for ax in [ax_dino, ax_siglip]:
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)

plt.savefig(OUT_DIR / 'grad_norm_heatmap.pdf')
plt.savefig(OUT_DIR / 'grad_norm_heatmap.png')
print(f'Saved to {OUT_DIR / "grad_norm_heatmap.pdf"}')
print(f'Saved to {OUT_DIR / "grad_norm_heatmap.png"}')
plt.close()

    for i, (prefix, backbone_name) in enumerate(BACKBONE_PREFIXES.items()):
        ax = axes[i]
        for cond, data in results.items():
            style = get_style(cond)
            blocks = extract_blocks(data["per_layer"], prefix)

            ys = [b[1]["action_grad_norm_mean"] for b in blocks]
            ax.plot(xs, ys, marker=style["marker"], ls=style["ls"],
                    color=style["color"], label=style["label"],
                    markersize=4, linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.85)

        ax.set_xlabel("Block Index")
        ax.set_ylabel("Action Gradient L2 Norm" if i == 0 else "")
        ax.set_title(f"{backbone_name}")
        ax.set_yscale("log")
        ax.legend(loc="best", framealpha=0.9)

def plot_gradient_amplification(results, output_dir, dpi):
    """Fig 3: Action gradient ratio (Full OCC / Detach) per backbone, comparing BN vs LN."""
    pairs = [
        ("full_occ_bn", "detach_bn", "BN"),
        ("full_occ_ln", "detach_ln", "LN"),
    ]
    available_pairs = [(f, d, l) for f, d, l in pairs if f in results and d in results]
    if not available_pairs:
        print("No full/detach pairs available, skipping amplification plot")
        return

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 4.5), sharey=True)
    colors_pair = {"BN": "#9C27B0", "LN": "#009688"}

    for i, (prefix, backbone_name) in enumerate(BACKBONE_PREFIXES.items()):
        ax = axes[i]
        for full_cond, detach_cond, norm_label in available_pairs:
            full_blocks = {b[0]: b[1] for b in extract_blocks(results[full_cond]["per_layer"], prefix)}
            detach_blocks = {b[0]: b[1] for b in extract_blocks(results[detach_cond]["per_layer"], prefix)}
            common = sorted(set(full_blocks) & set(detach_blocks))
            xs, ys = [], []
            for idx in common:
                f_val = full_blocks[idx]["action_grad_norm_mean"]
                d_val = detach_blocks[idx]["action_grad_norm_mean"]
                if f_val > 0 and d_val > 0:
                    xs.append(idx)
                    ys.append(f_val / d_val)
            ax.plot(xs, ys, "o-", color=colors_pair[norm_label],
                    label=f"{norm_label} (Full/Detach)", markersize=4, linewidth=1.5)

        ax.axhline(y=1, color="gray", linestyle="--", alpha=0.5, linewidth=1)
        ax.set_xlabel("Block Index")
        ax.set_ylabel("Gradient Ratio (Full OCC / Detach)" if i == 0 else "")
        ax.set_title(f"{backbone_name}")
        ax.set_yscale("log")
        ax.legend(loc="best", framealpha=0.9)

    fig.suptitle("Action Gradient Amplification by OCC Task", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=1.02)
    plt.tight_layout()
    for ext in ("pdf", "png"):
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(output_dir, f"gradient_amplification.{ext}"), dpi=dpi)
    plt.close(fig)
    print("Saved: gradient_amplification.pdf/png")

g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
    B = BATCH_SIZE

    pixel_values = torch.randn(B, 6, 224, 224, generator=g, dtype=torch.bfloat16).to(device)

    prompt = ("In: What action should the robot take to pick up the red block "
              "and place it on the table?\n")
    enc = processor.tokenizer(prompt, return_tensors="pt", padding=False)
    prompt_ids = enc.input_ids
    prompt_len = prompt_ids.shape[1]

    n_act = NUM_ACTIONS_CHUNK * ACTION_DIM  # 56
    act_ids = torch.randint(
        ACTION_TOKEN_BEGIN_IDX, ACTION_TOKEN_BEGIN_IDX + 256,
        (B, n_act), generator=g
    )

    input_ids = torch.cat([prompt_ids.expand(B, -1), act_ids], dim=1).to(device)
    attention_mask = torch.ones_like(input_ids)

    labels = torch.full_like(input_ids, IGNORE_INDEX)
    labels[:, prompt_len:] = act_ids.to(device)

    occ_labels = (torch.rand(B, 64, 64, generator=g) > 0.85).float().to(device)

    return {
        "input_ids": input_ids,
        "attention_mask": attention_mask,
        "pixel_values": pixel_values,
        "labels": labels,
        "occ_labels": occ_labels,
    }


def analyze_one(name, info):
    """Run gradient analysis on a single checkpoint."""
    print(f"\n{'='*60}\nAnalyzing: {name}\n{'='*60}")
    path = info["path"]
    has_occ = info["has_occ"]
    occ_detach = info["occ_detach"]

    # Load model (merged LoRA checkpoint)
    print(f"Loading model...")
    model = AutoModelForVision2Seq.from_pretrained(
        path, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, low_cpu_mem_usage=True, trust_remote_code=True
    ).to(DEVICE).eval()

    processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(path, trust_remote_code=True)

    # Vision backbone dimensions
    dino_dim = model.vision_backbone.featurizer.embed_dim
    siglip_dim = (model.vision_backbone.fused_featurizer.embed_dim
                  if model.vision_backbone.use_fused_vision_backbone else 0)
    total_dim = dino_dim + siglip_dim
    print(f"Vision dims: DINOv2={dino_dim}, SigLIP={siglip_dim}, total={total_dim}")

    # Load OCC head
    occ_head, occ_fn = None, None
    if has_occ:
        occ_head = BEVOccupancyHead(in_dim=total_dim)
        sd = torch.load(
            os.path.join(path, "occ_head--50000_checkpoint.pt"),
            map_location="cpu", weights_only=True
        )
        occ_head.load_state_dict({k.replace("module.", ""): v for k, v in sd.items()})
        occ_head = occ_head.to(torch.bfloat16).to(DEVICE).eval()
        occ_fn = FocalLoss()
        print("OCC head loaded")

    # Monkey-patch _process_vision_features to capture patch_features with grad
    pf_ref = [None]

    def patched_process(self, pixel_values, language_embeddings=None, use_film=False):
        if use_film:
            pf = self.vision_backbone(pixel_values, language_embeddings)
        else:
            pf = self.vision_backbone(pixel_values)
        # Detach from frozen backbone, enable grad for analysis
        pf = pf.detach().requires_grad_(True)
        self._cached_patch_features = pf
        pf_ref[0] = pf
        return self.projector(pf)

    model._process_vision_features = types.MethodType(patched_process, model)

    # Enable grad on projector params (for projector gradient analysis)
    for p in model.projector.parameters():
        p.requires_grad_(True)

    # Collect per-batch metrics
    metrics = {k: [] for k in [
        "action_grad_norm", "occ_grad_norm", "cosine_sim", "conflict_rate",
        "dino_grad_norm", "siglip_grad_norm", "proj_action_grad_norm",
    ]}

    for batch_idx in range(NUM_BATCHES):
        batch = create_batch(processor, DEVICE, SEED + batch_idx)
        model.zero_grad()
        if occ_head is not None:
            occ_head.zero_grad()

        # Forward pass -> CE loss on action tokens
        output = model(
            input_ids=batch["input_ids"],
            attention_mask=batch["attention_mask"],
            pixel_values=batch["pixel_values"],
            labels=batch["labels"],
        )

        pf = pf_ref[0]
        action_loss = output.loss
        proj_params = list(model.projector.parameters())

        # Compute action gradient on patch_features + projector
        grads = torch.autograd.grad(
            action_loss, [pf] + proj_params,
            retain_graph=has_occ,
            allow_unused=True,
        )

        ag = grads[0].float()  # Action gradient on patch_features

        metrics["action_grad_norm"].append(ag.norm().item())
        metrics["dino_grad_norm"].append(ag[:, :, :dino_dim].norm().item())
        metrics["siglip_grad_norm"].append(ag[:, :, dino_dim:].norm().item())
        metrics["proj_action_grad_norm"].append(
            sum(g.float().norm().item()**2 for g in grads[1:] if g is not None)**0.5
        )

        # OCC gradient on patch_features
        if has_occ:
            # For detach: compute OCC grad on a detached copy
            # For full_occ: compute OCC grad on the same pf (still connected to action graph)
            if occ_detach:
                occ_in = pf.detach().requires_grad_(True)
            else:
                occ_in = pf

            occ_logits = occ_head(occ_in)
            occ_loss = occ_fn(occ_logits.float(), batch["occ_labels"])

            og = torch.autograd.grad(occ_loss, [occ_in], allow_unused=True)[0].float()

            metrics["occ_grad_norm"].append(og.norm().item())

            a_flat = ag.flatten()
            o_flat = og.flatten()
            cos = F.cosine_similarity(a_flat.unsqueeze(0), o_flat.unsqueeze(0)).item()
            conf = (a_flat * o_flat < 0).float().mean().item()
            metrics["cosine_sim"].append(cos)
            metrics["conflict_rate"].append(conf)

            print(f"  Batch {batch_idx}: action={metrics['action_grad_norm'][-1]:.6f} "
                  f"occ={og.norm().item():.6f} cos={cos:.4f} conflict={conf:.4f}")
        else:
            print(f"  Batch {batch_idx}: action={metrics['action_grad_norm'][-1]:.6f} "
                  f"dino={metrics['dino_grad_norm'][-1]:.6f} siglip={metrics['siglip_grad_norm'][-1]:.6f}")

    # Aggregate results
    result = {
        "name": name,
        "has_occ": has_occ,
        "occ_detach": occ_detach,
        "checkpoint_path": path,
        "action_grad_norm": {

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Per-layer gradient conflict rate figure for the paper.

Narrative intent: DINOv2 layers show ~50% conflict (direction-independent
anti-freeze), while SigLIP late layers drop to 19-25% (cooperative gradient
alignment). Both Full OCC and Random OCC show identical patterns, confirming
architectural structure rather than label content.
"""

import csv
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 12,
    'axes.labelsize': 11,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 9.5,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

COLORS = {
    'full_occ': '#0072B2',
    'random':   '#E69F00',
}

SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).parent
CSV_PATH = SCRIPT_DIR / 'per_layer_conflict_rate.csv'
OUT_DIR = Path('/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513/projects/occsafe_vla/docs/paper/figures')

# --- Load data ---
data = {}
with open(CSV_PATH) as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        cond = row['condition']
        enc = row['encoder']
        idx = int(row['layer_idx'])
        cr = float(row['conflict_rate'])
        cos = float(row['cosine_sim'])
        key = (cond, enc)
        if key not in data:
            data[key] = {'idx': [], 'conflict_rate': [], 'cosine_sim': []}
        data[key]['idx'].append(idx)
        data[key]['conflict_rate'].append(cr)
        data[key]['cosine_sim'].append(cos)

# --- Figure ---
fig, (ax_dino, ax_siglip) = plt.subplots(
    1, 2, figsize=(7.2, 2.8),
    gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [23, 26], 'wspace': 0.14},
    sharey=True
)

# DINOv2 panel
for cond, color, label in [
    ('Full_OCC_s0', COLORS['full_occ'], 'Full OCC'),
    ('Random_s2',   COLORS['random'],   'Random OCC'),
]:
    d = data[(cond, 'dino')]
    ax_dino.plot(d['idx'], d['conflict_rate'], color=color, label=label,
                 linewidth=1.6, alpha=0.85, marker='o', markersize=3,
                 markeredgewidth=0, zorder=3)

# 50% reference line
ax_dino.axhline(0.5, color='#888888', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.5, zorder=1)
ax_dino.text(22, 0.503, '50%', fontsize=7.5, color='#888888', ha='right', va='bottom')

ax_dino.set_xlim(-0.5, 22.5)
ax_dino.set_ylim(0.12, 0.52)
ax_dino.set_xlabel('DINOv2 block index')
ax_dino.set_ylabel('Gradient conflict rate')
ax_dino.set_title('(a) DINOv2: anti-freeze ($\\approx$50% conflict)', fontsize=10.5, pad=8)
ax_dino.set_xticks([0, 5, 10, 15, 20])

# Subtle group separators
for x in [8, 16]:
    ax_dino.axvline(x - 0.5, color='#cccccc', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.6, zorder=0)

ax_dino.legend(loc='lower left', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='none')

# SigLIP panel
for cond, color, label in [
    ('Full_OCC_s0', COLORS['full_occ'], 'Full OCC'),
    ('Random_s2',   COLORS['random'],   'Random OCC'),
]:
    d = data[(cond, 'siglip')]
    ax_siglip.plot(d['idx'], d['conflict_rate'], color=color, label=label,
                   linewidth=1.6, alpha=0.85, marker='o', markersize=3,
                   markeredgewidth=0, zorder=3)

ax_siglip.axhline(0.5, color='#888888', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.5, zorder=1)
ax_siglip.text(25, 0.503, '50%', fontsize=7.5, color='#888888', ha='right', va='bottom')

# Cooperative zone highlight (blocks 19-24 core drop)
ax_siglip.axvspan(18.5, 25.5, alpha=0.07, color='#D55E00', zorder=0)

# Single clean annotation
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
t = ax_siglip.text(
    14.0, 0.14, 'cooperative zone\n(19–25% conflict)',
    fontsize=8, color='#D55E00', fontstyle='italic',
    ha='center', va='center', alpha=0.85
)
t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])

ax_siglip.annotate(
    '', xy=(19.5, 0.19), xytext=(16.5, 0.155),
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#D55E00', lw=0.8, alpha=0.7)
)

ax_siglip.set_xlim(-0.5, 25.5)
ax_siglip.set_xlabel('SigLIP block index')
ax_siglip.set_title('(b) SigLIP: cooperative in late layers', fontsize=10.5, pad=8)
ax_siglip.set_xticks([0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25])

# Group separators
for x in [9, 17]:
    ax_siglip.axvline(x - 0.5, color='#cccccc', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.6, zorder=0)

ax_siglip.yaxis.set_tick_params(labelleft=False)

# Subtle grid
for ax in [ax_dino, ax_siglip]:
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.15, axis='y', zorder=0)
    ax.tick_params(axis='both', which='both', length=3)

plt.savefig(OUT_DIR / 'per_layer_conflict_rate.pdf')
plt.savefig(OUT_DIR / 'per_layer_conflict_rate.png')
print(f'Saved to {OUT_DIR / "per_layer_conflict_rate.pdf"}')
print(f'Saved to {OUT_DIR / "per_layer_conflict_rate.png"}')
plt.close()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""V2 Gradient Analysis Paper Figures for OccSafe-VLA.

Generates three publication-quality figures from per-layer gradient analysis:
  Fig 1: Gradient magnitude heatmap (conditions × layer, log-scale)
  Fig 2: Cosine similarity curves (action vs OCC gradients per layer)
  Fig 3: Cross-seed CAR variance bar chart (2×2 factorial)

Input: .pt or .json files, one per experimental condition.

Expected .pt format per condition (structured):
  {
    'gradient_stats': {
      layer_name: {'grad_norm_mean': float, 'grad_norm_std': float,
                   'grad_norms': [float, ...]},
      ...
    },
    'cosine_stats': {  # optional, only for non-detach + OCC conditions
      layer_name: {'cosine_mean': float, 'cosine_std': float,
                   'conflict_rate': float},
      ...
    }
  }

Also supports:
  - Flat .pt: {layer_name: {'grad_norm_mean': ..., 'cosine_mean': ..., ...}}
  - same_seed JSON: {'condition': str, 'per_layer': {layer_name: {...}}}

Usage:
  # All figures
  python plot_gradient_analysis_v2_paper.py \
    --data vanilla_v2:results/vanilla.pt \
           full_occ_ln_v2:results/full_occ_ln.pt \
           detach_ln_v2:results/detach_ln.pt \
           full_occ_bn_v2:results/full_occ_bn.pt \
    --output_dir figures/

  # With CAR variance for Figure 3
  python plot_gradient_analysis_v2_paper.py \
    --data vanilla_v2:vanilla.pt \
    --car_variance "Full OCC BN=0.045" "Detach BN=0.0065" \
                   "Full OCC LN=0.012" "Detach LN=0.008" \
    --output_dir figures/

  # Specific figures only
  python plot_gradient_analysis_v2_paper.py \
    --data vanilla_v2:vanilla.pt full_occ_ln_v2:full_ln.pt \
    --figures heatmap cosine --output_dir figures/

  # Separate cosine data files
  python plot_gradient_analysis_v2_paper.py \
    --data full_occ_ln_v2:grad.pt detach_ln_v2:grad2.pt \
    --cosine_data full_occ_ln_v2:cosine.pt \
    --output_dir figures/
"""

import argparse
import json
import sys
from collections import OrderedDict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import seaborn as sns  # noqa: F401 — imported for style availability


# === Style ===
plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
    "font.size": 9,
    "axes.titlesize": 10,
    "axes.labelsize": 9,
    "xtick.labelsize": 8,
    "ytick.labelsize": 8,
    "legend.fontsize": 8,
    "figure.dpi": 300,
    "savefig.dpi": 300,
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.05,
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "lines.linewidth": 1.5,
})

# Okabe-Ito colorblind-friendly palette
CONDITION_STYLES = OrderedDict([
    ("vanilla_v2",     {"color": "#999999", "label": "Vanilla",     "marker": "x", "ls": ":"}),
    ("full_occ_bn_v2", {"color": "#009E73", "label": "Full OCC BN", "marker": "^", "ls": "-"}),
    ("full_occ_ln_v2", {"color": "#0072B2", "label": "Full OCC LN", "marker": "o", "ls": "-"}),
    ("detach_bn_v2",   {"color": "#CC79A7", "label": "Detach BN",   "marker": "D", "ls": "--"}),
    ("detach_ln_v2",   {"color": "#D55E00", "label": "Detach LN",   "marker": "s", "ls": "--"}),
])

ENCODERS = OrderedDict([
    ("featurizer",       {"name": "DINOv2", "n_blocks": 23}),
    ("fused_featurizer", {"name": "SigLIP", "n_blocks": 26}),
])

# Colors for factorial cells in Figure 3
FACTORIAL_COLORS = {
    "full occ bn": "#0072B2",
    "full occ ln": "#009E73",
    "detach bn":   "#D55E00",
    "detach ln":   "#E69F00",
}


# ====================================================================
# Argument parsing
# ====================================================================

def parse_args():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="V2 gradient analysis paper figures for OccSafe-VLA",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--data", nargs="+", metavar="NAME:PATH",
        help="Gradient data files as NAME:PATH pairs "
             "(e.g., vanilla_v2:results/vanilla.pt)",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--cosine_data", nargs="+", metavar="NAME:PATH", default=None,
        help="Separate cosine similarity files if not in --data files",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--car_variance", nargs="+", metavar='"NAME=VALUE"', default=None,
        help='CAR std values for Fig 3 (e.g., "Full OCC BN=0.045")',
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--output_dir", type=str, required=True,
        help="Output directory for PDF/PNG figures",
    )
    p.add_argument("--dpi", type=int, default=300)
    p.add_argument(
        "--figures", nargs="+", default=None,
        choices=["heatmap", "cosine", "variance", "all"],
        help="Which figures to generate (default: all available)",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--prefix", type=str, default="v2",
        help="Output filename prefix (default: v2)",
    )
    return p.parse_args()


# ====================================================================
# Data loading / normalization
# ====================================================================

def _norm_grad(stats):
    """Normalize gradient stat entry to {mean, std, values}."""
    return {
        "mean": stats.get("grad_norm_mean",
                          stats.get("action_grad_norm_mean", 0)),
        "std":  stats.get("grad_norm_std",
                          stats.get("action_grad_norm_std", 0)),
        "values": stats.get("grad_norms",
                            stats.get("values", [])),
    }


def _norm_cos(stats):
    """Normalize cosine stat entry to {mean, std, conflict_rate}."""
    return {
        "mean": stats.get("cosine_mean",
                          stats.get("cosine_sim_mean")),
        "std":  stats.get("cosine_std",
                          stats.get("cosine_sim_std", 0)),
        "conflict_rate": stats.get("conflict_rate"),
    }


def load_data(path_str):
    """Load gradient/cosine data from .pt or .json, normalize to:
      {'gradient': {layer: {...}}, 'cosine': {layer: {...}}}
    """
    path = Path(path_str)
    if path.suffix == ".pt":
        raw = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    elif path.suffix == ".json":
        with open(path) as f:
            raw = json.load(f)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported file format: {path.suffix}")

    gradient, cosine = {}, {}

    # Format A: structured {'gradient_stats': ..., 'cosine_stats': ...}
    if "gradient_stats" in raw:
        for layer, s in raw["gradient_stats"].items():
            gradient[layer] = _norm_grad(s)
        for layer, s in (raw.get("cosine_stats") or {}).items():
            cosine[layer] = _norm_cos(s)

    # Format B: same_seed JSON {'per_layer': {layer: {...}}}
    elif "per_layer" in raw:
        for layer, s in raw["per_layer"].items():
            gradient[layer] = _norm_grad(s)
            cos_mean = s.get("cosine_sim_mean", s.get("cosine_mean"))
            if cos_mean is not None:
                cosine[layer] = _norm_cos(s)

    # Format C: flat {layer_name: {grad_norm_mean, cosine_mean, ...}}
    else:
        for layer, s in raw.items():
            if not isinstance(s, dict):
                continue
            if any(k in s for k in ("grad_norm_mean", "action_grad_norm_mean")):
                gradient[layer] = _norm_grad(s)
            if any(k in s for k in ("cosine_mean", "cosine_sim_mean")):
                cosine[layer] = _norm_cos(s)

    return {"gradient": gradient, "cosine": cosine}


def extract_encoder_blocks(per_layer, prefix):
    """Extract blocks for encoder prefix, deduplicated and sorted by index."""
    seen = {}
    for layer_name, stats in per_layer.items():
        if layer_name.startswith(f"{prefix}.blocks."):
            idx = int(layer_name.split(".")[2])
            if idx not in seen:
                seen[idx] = stats
    return sorted(seen.items())


def get_style(cond):
    """Look up plotting style; falls back to grey if unknown."""
    if cond in CONDITION_STYLES:
        return CONDITION_STYLES[cond]
    base = cond.replace("_v2", "")
    for k, v in CONDITION_STYLES.items():
        if k.replace("_v2", "") == base:
            return v
    return {"color": "#888888", "label": cond, "marker": ".", "ls": "-"}


# ====================================================================
# Figure 1: Gradient Magnitude Heatmap
# ====================================================================

def plot_gradient_heatmap(all_data, output_dir, dpi, prefix):
    """Two-panel heatmap (DINOv2 + SigLIP): conditions × layers, log scale."""
    cond_order = [c for c in CONDITION_STYLES if c in all_data]
    if not cond_order:
        cond_order = list(all_data.keys())
    if not cond_order:
        print("No gradient data for heatmap, skipping")
        return

    enc_list = list(ENCODERS.items())
    matrices = []
    for enc_key, enc_info in enc_list:
        n_b = enc_info["n_blocks"]
        mat = np.full((len(cond_order), n_b), np.nan)
        for ci, cond in enumerate(cond_order):
            for idx, stats in extract_encoder_blocks(
                    all_data[cond]["gradient"], enc_key):
                if idx < n_b:
                    mat[ci, idx] = stats["mean"]
        matrices.append(mat)

    all_vals = np.concatenate([m[np.isfinite(m)] for m in matrices])
    if len(all_vals) == 0:
        print("No finite gradient values for heatmap, skipping")
        return

    norm = mcolors.LogNorm(vmin=max(all_vals.min(), 1e-6), vmax=all_vals.max())
    cmap = plt.cm.inferno.copy()
    cmap.set_bad(color="#f0f0f0")

    width_ratios = [ENCODERS[e]["n_blocks"] for e in ENCODERS]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1, len(enc_list),
        figsize=(7.5, 0.45 * len(cond_order) + 0.8),
        gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": width_ratios, "wspace": 0.06},
        sharey=True,
    )
    if len(enc_list) == 1:
        axes = [axes]

    cond_labels = [get_style(c)["label"] for c in cond_order]
    im = None

    for i, ((enc_key, enc_info), mat) in enumerate(zip(enc_list, matrices)):
        ax = axes[i]
        im = ax.imshow(mat, aspect="auto", cmap=cmap, norm=norm,
                        interpolation="nearest")

        n_b = enc_info["n_blocks"]
        xticks = list(range(0, n_b, 5))
        if n_b - 1 not in xticks:
            xticks.append(n_b - 1)
        ax.set_xticks(xticks)
        ax.set_xticklabels([str(t) for t in xticks])

        if i == 0:
            ax.set_yticks(range(len(cond_labels)))
            ax.set_yticklabels(cond_labels)
        else:
            ax.yaxis.set_tick_params(labelleft=False)

        sub = chr(ord("a") + i)
        ax.set_xlabel(f"{enc_info['name']} block index")
        ax.set_title(f"({sub}) {enc_info['name']}", fontsize=10, pad=6)

        for spine in ax.spines.values():
            spine.set_visible(False)

    fig.colorbar(
        im, ax=axes, location="right", fraction=0.02, pad=0.02,
        label="Gradient norm (log scale)",
    )

    _save(fig, output_dir, f"{prefix}_grad_heatmap", dpi)


# ====================================================================
# Figure 2: Cosine Similarity Curves
# ====================================================================

def plot_cosine_similarity(all_data, output_dir, dpi, prefix):
    """Two-panel line plot: cosine similarity per layer with shaded std."""
    conds = [c for c in CONDITION_STYLES if c in all_data and all_data[c]["cosine"]]
    if not conds:
        conds = [c for c in all_data if all_data[c]["cosine"]]
    if not conds:
        print("No cosine similarity data, skipping")
        return

    enc_list = list(ENCODERS.items())
    width_ratios = [ENCODERS[e]["n_blocks"] for e in ENCODERS]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1, len(enc_list),
        figsize=(7.2, 2.8),
        gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": width_ratios, "wspace": 0.14},
        sharey=True,
    )
    if len(enc_list) == 1:
        axes = [axes]

    for i, (enc_key, enc_info) in enumerate(enc_list):
        ax = axes[i]
        for cond in conds:
            style = get_style(cond)
            blocks = extract_encoder_blocks(all_data[cond]["cosine"], enc_key)
            if not blocks:
                continue
            xs = np.array([b[0] for b in blocks])
            ys = np.array([b[1]["mean"] for b in blocks], dtype=float)
            stds = np.array([b[1].get("std", 0) or 0 for b in blocks],
                            dtype=float)

            ax.plot(xs, ys, color=style["color"], label=style["label"],
                    marker=style["marker"], markersize=3, linewidth=1.4,
                    ls=style["ls"], alpha=0.85, markeredgewidth=0)
            ax.fill_between(xs, ys - stds, ys + stds,
                            alpha=0.12, color=style["color"])

        ax.axhline(0, color="#888888", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.7,
                    alpha=0.5, zorder=1)
        ax.set_ylim(-1, 1)
        ax.set_xlim(-0.5, enc_info["n_blocks"] - 0.5)
        ax.set_xticks(range(0, enc_info["n_blocks"], 5))
        ax.set_xlabel(f"{enc_info['name']} block index")

        if i == 0:
            ax.set_ylabel("Cosine similarity")
        else:
            ax.yaxis.set_tick_params(labelleft=False)

        sub = chr(ord("a") + i)
        ax.set_title(f"({sub}) {enc_info['name']}", fontsize=10, pad=6)
        ax.legend(loc="best", framealpha=0.9, edgecolor="none")
        ax.grid(True, alpha=0.15, axis="y")

    _save(fig, output_dir, f"{prefix}_cosine_similarity", dpi)


# ====================================================================
# Figure 3: Cross-seed CAR Variance Bar Chart
# ====================================================================

def plot_car_variance(variance_specs, output_dir, dpi, prefix):
    """Bar chart comparing cross-seed CAR variance across factorial cells.

    Args:
        variance_specs: list of "NAME=VALUE" strings
    """
    if not variance_specs:
        print("No CAR variance data, skipping")
        return

    names, values = [], []
    for spec in variance_specs:
        name, val = spec.rsplit("=", 1)
        names.append(name.strip())
        values.append(float(val.strip()))
    values = np.array(values)

    colors = []
    for name in names:
        nl = name.lower()
        matched = False
        for key, col in FACTORIAL_COLORS.items():
            if key in nl:
                colors.append(col)
                matched = True
                break
        if not matched:
            colors.append("#999999")

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 3.0))
    x = np.arange(len(names))
    bars = ax.bar(x, values, width=0.55, color=colors,
                  edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.5)

    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(names, fontsize=8)
    ax.set_ylabel("Cross-seed CAR std")
    ax.set_title("Variance across factorial cells", fontsize=10)

    # Value labels
    for bar, val in zip(bars, values):
        ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
                val + values.max() * 0.01,
                f"{val:.4f}", ha="center", va="bottom",
                fontsize=7, color="#444444")

    # Annotate max/min ratio with bracket
    if len(values) >= 2:
        imax, imin = int(np.argmax(values)), int(np.argmin(values))
        if values[imin] > 0:
            ratio = values[imax] / values[imin]
            bracket_y = values[imax] * 1.08
            i_left, i_right = min(imax, imin), max(imax, imin)
            ax.plot(
                [x[i_left], x[i_left], x[i_right], x[i_right]],
                [values[i_left] * 1.02, bracket_y, bracket_y,
                 values[i_right] * 1.02],
                color="#555555", linewidth=0.8,
            )
            ax.text(
                (x[i_left] + x[i_right]) / 2, bracket_y * 1.03,
                f"{ratio:.2f}×",
                fontsize=9, fontweight="bold", ha="center", va="bottom",
                color="#333333",
            )

    ax.set_ylim(0, values.max() * 1.35)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.15, axis="y")

    _save(fig, output_dir, f"{prefix}_car_variance", dpi)


# ====================================================================
# Helpers
# ====================================================================

def _save(fig, output_dir, stem, dpi):
    out = Path(output_dir)
    for ext in ("pdf", "png"):
        fig.savefig(out / f"{stem}.{ext}", dpi=dpi)
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f"Saved: {stem}.pdf / {stem}.png -> {out}")


# ====================================================================
# Main
# ====================================================================

def main():
    args = parse_args()
    out = Path(args.output_dir)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    figures = args.figures or ["all"]
    if "all" in figures:
        figures = ["heatmap", "cosine", "variance"]

    all_data = OrderedDict()
    if args.data:
        for spec in args.data:
            if ":" not in spec:
                print(f"Warning: skipping '{spec}' "
                      f"(expected NAME:PATH)", file=sys.stderr)
                continue
            name, path = spec.split(":", 1)
            all_data[name] = load_data(path)
            n_grad = len(all_data[name]["gradient"])
            n_cos = len(all_data[name]["cosine"])
            print(f"Loaded {name}: {n_grad} gradient layers, "
                  f"{n_cos} cosine layers")

    if args.cosine_data:
        for spec in args.cosine_data:
            name, path = spec.split(":", 1)
            extra = load_data(path)
            if name in all_data:
                all_data[name]["cosine"].update(extra.get("cosine", {}))
                if not extra["cosine"] and extra["gradient"]:
                    all_data[name]["cosine"].update(extra["gradient"])
            else:
                all_data[name] = extra
            print(f"Loaded cosine data for {name}: {path}")

    if not all_data and "variance" not in figures:
        print("Error: no data. Use --data NAME:PATH.", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    pfx = args.prefix

    if "heatmap" in figures and all_data:
        plot_gradient_heatmap(all_data, args.output_dir, args.dpi, pfx)

    if "cosine" in figures and all_data:
        plot_cosine_similarity(all_data, args.output_dir, args.dpi, pfx)

    if "variance" in figures:
        if args.car_variance:
            plot_car_variance(
                args.car_variance, args.output_dir, args.dpi, pfx)
        else:
            print("Skipping variance figure (no --car_variance provided)")

    print("Done.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""V2 Gradient Analysis Paper Figures for OccSafe-VLA.

Generates three publication-quality figures from per-layer gradient analysis:
  Fig 1: Gradient magnitude heatmap (conditions × layer, log-scale)
  Fig 2: Cosine similarity curves (action vs OCC gradients per layer)
  Fig 3: Cross-seed CAR variance bar chart (2×2 factorial)

Input: .pt or .json files, one per experimental condition.

Expected .pt format per condition (structured):
  {
    'gradient_stats': {
      layer_name: {'grad_norm_mean': float, 'grad_norm_std': float,
                   'grad_norms': [float, ...]},
      ...
    },
    'cosine_stats': {  # optional, only for non-detach + OCC conditions
      layer_name: {'cosine_mean': float, 'cosine_std': float,
                   'conflict_rate': float},
      ...
    }
  }

Also supports:
  - Flat .pt: {layer_name: {'grad_norm_mean': ..., 'cosine_mean': ..., ...}}
  - same_seed JSON: {'condition': str, 'per_layer': {layer_name: {...}}}

Usage:
  # All figures
  python plot_gradient_analysis_v2_paper.py \
    --data vanilla_v2:results/vanilla.pt \
           full_occ_ln_v2:results/full_occ_ln.pt \
           detach_ln_v2:results/detach_ln.pt \
           full_occ_bn_v2:results/full_occ_bn.pt \
    --output_dir figures/

  # With CAR variance for Figure 3
  python plot_gradient_analysis_v2_paper.py \
    --data vanilla_v2:vanilla.pt \
    --car_variance "Full OCC BN=0.045" "Detach BN=0.0065" \
                   "Full OCC LN=0.012" "Detach LN=0.008" \
    --output_dir figures/

  # Specific figures only
  python plot_gradient_analysis_v2_paper.py \
    --data vanilla_v2:vanilla.pt full_occ_ln_v2:full_ln.pt \
    --figures heatmap cosine --output_dir figures/

  # Separate cosine data files
  python plot_gradient_analysis_v2_paper.py \
    --data full_occ_ln_v2:grad.pt detach_ln_v2:grad2.pt \
    --cosine_data full_occ_ln_v2:cosine.pt \
    --output_dir figures/
"""

import argparse
import json
import sys
from collections import OrderedDict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import seaborn as sns  # noqa: F401 — imported for style availability


# === Style ===
plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
    "font.size": 9,
    "axes.titlesize": 10,
    "axes.labelsize": 9,
    "xtick.labelsize": 8,
    "ytick.labelsize": 8,
    "legend.fontsize": 8,
    "figure.dpi": 300,
    "savefig.dpi": 300,
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.05,
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "lines.linewidth": 1.5,
})

# Okabe-Ito colorblind-friendly palette
CONDITION_STYLES = OrderedDict([
    ("vanilla_v2",     {"color": "#999999", "label": "Vanilla",     "marker": "x", "ls": ":"}),
    ("full_occ_bn_v2", {"color": "#009E73", "label": "Full OCC BN", "marker": "^", "ls": "-"}),
    ("full_occ_ln_v2", {"color": "#0072B2", "label": "Full OCC LN", "marker": "o", "ls": "-"}),
    ("detach_bn_v2",   {"color": "#CC79A7", "label": "Detach BN",   "marker": "D", "ls": "--"}),
    ("detach_ln_v2",   {"color": "#D55E00", "label": "Detach LN",   "marker": "s", "ls": "--"}),
])

ENCODERS = OrderedDict([
    ("featurizer",       {"name": "DINOv2", "n_blocks": 23}),
    ("fused_featurizer", {"name": "SigLIP", "n_blocks": 26}),
])

# Colors for factorial cells in Figure 3
FACTORIAL_COLORS = {
    "full occ bn": "#0072B2",
    "full occ ln": "#009E73",
    "detach bn":   "#D55E00",
    "detach ln":   "#E69F00",
}


# ====================================================================
# Argument parsing
# ====================================================================

def parse_args():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="V2 gradient analysis paper figures for OccSafe-VLA",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--data", nargs="+", metavar="NAME:PATH",
        help="Gradient data files as NAME:PATH pairs "
             "(e.g., vanilla_v2:results/vanilla.pt)",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--cosine_data", nargs="+", metavar="NAME:PATH", default=None,
        help="Separate cosine similarity files if not in --data files",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--car_variance", nargs="+", metavar='"NAME=VALUE"', default=None,
        help='CAR std values for Fig 3 (e.g., "Full OCC BN=0.045")',
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--output_dir", type=str, required=True,
        help="Output directory for PDF/PNG figures",
    )
    p.add_argument("--dpi", type=int, default=300)
    p.add_argument(
        "--figures", nargs="+", default=None,
        choices=["heatmap", "cosine", "variance", "all"],
        help="Which figures to generate (default: all available)",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--prefix", type=str, default="v2",
        help="Output filename prefix (default: v2)",
    )
    return p.parse_args()


# ====================================================================
# Data loading / normalization
# ====================================================================

def _norm_grad(stats):
    """Normalize gradient stat entry to {mean, std, values}."""
    return {
        "mean": stats.get("grad_norm_mean",
                          stats.get("action_grad_norm_mean", 0)),
        "std":  stats.get("grad_norm_std",
                          stats.get("action_grad_norm_std", 0)),
        "values": stats.get("grad_norms",
                            stats.get("values", [])),
    }


def _norm_cos(stats):
    """Normalize cosine stat entry to {mean, std, conflict_rate}."""
    return {
        "mean": stats.get("cosine_mean",
                          stats.get("cosine_sim_mean")),
        "std":  stats.get("cosine_std",
                          stats.get("cosine_sim_std", 0)),
        "conflict_rate": stats.get("conflict_rate"),
    }


def load_data(path_str):
    """Load gradient/cosine data from .pt or .json, normalize to:
      {'gradient': {layer: {...}}, 'cosine': {layer: {...}}}
    """
    path = Path(path_str)
    if path.suffix == ".pt":
        raw = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    elif path.suffix == ".json":
        with open(path) as f:
            raw = json.load(f)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported file format: {path.suffix}")

    gradient, cosine = {}, {}

    # Format A: structured {'gradient_stats': ..., 'cosine_stats': ...}
    if "gradient_stats" in raw:
        for layer, s in raw["gradient_stats"].items():
            gradient[layer] = _norm_grad(s)
        for layer, s in (raw.get("cosine_stats") or {}).items():
            cosine[layer] = _norm_cos(s)

    # Format B: same_seed JSON {'per_layer': {layer: {...}}}
    elif "per_layer" in raw:
        for layer, s in raw["per_layer"].items():
            gradient[layer] = _norm_grad(s)
            cos_mean = s.get("cosine_sim_mean", s.get("cosine_mean"))
            if cos_mean is not None:
                cosine[layer] = _norm_cos(s)

    # Format C: flat {layer_name: {grad_norm_mean, cosine_mean, ...}}
    else:
        for layer, s in raw.items():
            if not isinstance(s, dict):
                continue
            if any(k in s for k in ("grad_norm_mean", "action_grad_norm_mean")):
                gradient[layer] = _norm_grad(s)
            if any(k in s for k in ("cosine_mean", "cosine_sim_mean")):
                cosine[layer] = _norm_cos(s)

    return {"gradient": gradient, "cosine": cosine}


def extract_encoder_blocks(per_layer, prefix):
    """Extract blocks for encoder prefix, deduplicated and sorted by index."""
    seen = {}
    for layer_name, stats in per_layer.items():
        if layer_name.startswith(f"{prefix}.blocks."):
            idx = int(layer_name.split(".")[2])
            if idx not in seen:
                seen[idx] = stats
    return sorted(seen.items())


def get_style(cond):
    """Look up plotting style; falls back to grey if unknown."""
    if cond in CONDITION_STYLES:
        return CONDITION_STYLES[cond]
    base = cond.replace("_v2", "")
    for k, v in CONDITION_STYLES.items():
        if k.replace("_v2", "") == base:
            return v
    return {"color": "#888888", "label": cond, "marker": ".", "ls": "-"}


# ====================================================================
# Figure 1: Gradient Magnitude Heatmap
# ====================================================================

def plot_gradient_heatmap(all_data, output_dir, dpi, prefix):
    """Two-panel heatmap (DINOv2 + SigLIP): conditions × layers, log scale."""
    cond_order = [c for c in CONDITION_STYLES if c in all_data]
    if not cond_order:
        cond_order = list(all_data.keys())
    if not cond_order:
        print("No gradient data for heatmap, skipping")
        return

    enc_list = list(ENCODERS.items())
    matrices = []
    for enc_key, enc_info in enc_list:
        n_b = enc_info["n_blocks"]
        mat = np.full((len(cond_order), n_b), np.nan)
        for ci, cond in enumerate(cond_order):
            for idx, stats in extract_encoder_blocks(
                    all_data[cond]["gradient"], enc_key):
                if idx < n_b:
                    mat[ci, idx] = stats["mean"]
        matrices.append(mat)

    all_vals = np.concatenate([m[np.isfinite(m)] for m in matrices])
    if len(all_vals) == 0:
        print("No finite gradient values for heatmap, skipping")
        return

    norm = mcolors.LogNorm(vmin=max(all_vals.min(), 1e-6), vmax=all_vals.max())
    cmap = plt.cm.inferno.copy()
    cmap.set_bad(color="#f0f0f0")

    width_ratios = [ENCODERS[e]["n_blocks"] for e in ENCODERS]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1, len(enc_list),
        figsize=(7.5, 0.45 * len(cond_order) + 0.8),
        gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": width_ratios, "wspace": 0.06},
        sharey=True,
    )
    if len(enc_list) == 1:
        axes = [axes]

    cond_labels = [get_style(c)["label"] for c in cond_order]
    im = None

    for i, ((enc_key, enc_info), mat) in enumerate(zip(enc_list, matrices)):
        ax = axes[i]
        im = ax.imshow(mat, aspect="auto", cmap=cmap, norm=norm,
                        interpolation="nearest")

        n_b = enc_info["n_blocks"]
        xticks = list(range(0, n_b, 5))
        if n_b - 1 not in xticks:
            xticks.append(n_b - 1)
        ax.set_xticks(xticks)
        ax.set_xticklabels([str(t) for t in xticks])

        if i == 0:
            ax.set_yticks(range(len(cond_labels)))
            ax.set_yticklabels(cond_labels)
        else:
            ax.yaxis.set_tick_params(labelleft=False)

        sub = chr(ord("a") + i)
        ax.set_xlabel(f"{enc_info['name']} block index")
        ax.set_title(f"({sub}) {enc_info['name']}", fontsize=10, pad=6)

        for spine in ax.spines.values():
            spine.set_visible(False)

    fig.colorbar(
        im, ax=axes, location="right", fraction=0.02, pad=0.02,
        label="Gradient norm (log scale)",
    )

    _save(fig, output_dir, f"{prefix}_grad_heatmap", dpi)


# ====================================================================
# Figure 2: Cosine Similarity Curves
# ====================================================================

def plot_cosine_similarity(all_data, output_dir, dpi, prefix):
    """Two-panel line plot: cosine similarity per layer with shaded std."""
    conds = [c for c in CONDITION_STYLES if c in all_data and all_data[c]["cosine"]]
    if not conds:
        conds = [c for c in all_data if all_data[c]["cosine"]]
    if not conds:
        print("No cosine similarity data, skipping")
        return

    enc_list = list(ENCODERS.items())
    width_ratios = [ENCODERS[e]["n_blocks"] for e in ENCODERS]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1, len(enc_list),
        figsize=(7.2, 2.8),
        gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": width_ratios, "wspace": 0.14},
        sharey=True,
    )
    if len(enc_list) == 1:
        axes = [axes]

    for i, (enc_key, enc_info) in enumerate(enc_list):
        ax = axes[i]
        for cond in conds:
            style = get_style(cond)
            blocks = extract_encoder_blocks(all_data[cond]["cosine"], enc_key)
            if not blocks:
                continue
            xs = np.array([b[0] for b in blocks])
            ys = np.array([b[1]["mean"] for b in blocks], dtype=float)
            stds = np.array([b[1].get("std", 0) or 0 for b in blocks],
                            dtype=float)

            ax.plot(xs, ys, color=style["color"], label=style["label"],
                    marker=style["marker"], markersize=3, linewidth=1.4,
                    ls=style["ls"], alpha=0.85, markeredgewidth=0)
            ax.fill_between(xs, ys - stds, ys + stds,
                            alpha=0.12, color=style["color"])

        ax.axhline(0, color="#888888", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.7,
                    alpha=0.5, zorder=1)
        ax.set_ylim(-1, 1)
        ax.set_xlim(-0.5, enc_info["n_blocks"] - 0.5)
        ax.set_xticks(range(0, enc_info["n_blocks"], 5))
        ax.set_xlabel(f"{enc_info['name']} block index")

        if i == 0:
            ax.set_ylabel("Cosine similarity")
        else:
            ax.yaxis.set_tick_params(labelleft=False)

        sub = chr(ord("a") + i)
        ax.set_title(f"({sub}) {enc_info['name']}", fontsize=10, pad=6)
        ax.legend(loc="best", framealpha=0.9, edgecolor="none")
        ax.grid(True, alpha=0.15, axis="y")

    _save(fig, output_dir, f"{prefix}_cosine_similarity", dpi)


# ====================================================================
# Figure 3: Cross-seed CAR Variance Bar Chart
# ====================================================================

def plot_car_variance(variance_specs, output_dir, dpi, prefix):
    """Bar chart comparing cross-seed CAR variance across factorial cells.

    Args:
        variance_specs: list of "NAME=VALUE" strings
    """
    if not variance_specs:
        print("No CAR variance data, skipping")
        return

    names, values = [], []
    for spec in variance_specs:
        name, val = spec.rsplit("=", 1)
        names.append(name.strip())
        values.append(float(val.strip()))
    values = np.array(values)

    colors = []
    for name in names:
        nl = name.lower()
        matched = False
        for key, col in FACTORIAL_COLORS.items():
            if key in nl:
                colors.append(col)
                matched = True
                break
        if not matched:
            colors.append("#999999")

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 3.0))
    x = np.arange(len(names))
    bars = ax.bar(x, values, width=0.55, color=colors,
                  edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.5)

    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(names, fontsize=8)
    ax.set_ylabel("Cross-seed CAR std")
    ax.set_title("Variance across factorial cells", fontsize=10)

    # Value labels
    for bar, val in zip(bars, values):
        ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
                val + values.max() * 0.01,
                f"{val:.4f}", ha="center", va="bottom",
                fontsize=7, color="#444444")

    # Annotate max/min ratio with bracket
    if len(values) >= 2:
        imax, imin = int(np.argmax(values)), int(np.argmin(values))
        if values[imin] > 0:
            ratio = values[imax] / values[imin]
            bracket_y = values[imax] * 1.08
            i_left, i_right = min(imax, imin), max(imax, imin)
            ax.plot(
                [x[i_left], x[i_left], x[i_right], x[i_right]],
                [values[i_left] * 1.02, bracket_y, bracket_y,
                 values[i_right] * 1.02],
                color="#555555", linewidth=0.8,
            )
            ax.text(
                (x[i_left] + x[i_right]) / 2, bracket_y * 1.03,
                f"{ratio:.2f}×",
                fontsize=9, fontweight="bold", ha="center", va="bottom",
                color="#333333",
            )

    ax.set_ylim(0, values.max() * 1.35)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.15, axis="y")

    _save(fig, output_dir, f"{prefix}_car_variance", dpi)


# ====================================================================
# Helpers
# ====================================================================

def _save(fig, output_dir, stem, dpi):
    out = Path(output_dir)
    for ext in ("pdf", "png"):
        fig.savefig(out / f"{stem}.{ext}", dpi=dpi)
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f"Saved: {stem}.pdf / {stem}.png -> {out}")


# ====================================================================
# Main
# ====================================================================

def main():
    args = parse_args()
    out = Path(args.output_dir)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    figures = args.figures or ["all"]
    if "all" in figures:
        figures = ["heatmap", "cosine", "variance"]

    all_data = OrderedDict()
    if args.data:
        for spec in args.data:
            if ":" not in spec:
                print(f"Warning: skipping '{spec}' "
                      f"(expected NAME:PATH)", file=sys.stderr)
                continue
            name, path = spec.split(":", 1)
            all_data[name] = load_data(path)
            n_grad = len(all_data[name]["gradient"])
            n_cos = len(all_data[name]["cosine"])
            print(f"Loaded {name}: {n_grad} gradient layers, "
                  f"{n_cos} cosine layers")

    if args.cosine_data:
        for spec in args.cosine_data:
            name, path = spec.split(":", 1)
            extra = load_data(path)
            if name in all_data:
                all_data[name]["cosine"].update(extra.get("cosine", {}))
                if not extra["cosine"] and extra["gradient"]:
                    all_data[name]["cosine"].update(extra["gradient"])
            else:
                all_data[name] = extra
            print(f"Loaded cosine data for {name}: {path}")

    if not all_data and "variance" not in figures:
        print("Error: no data. Use --data NAME:PATH.", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    pfx = args.prefix

    if "heatmap" in figures and all_data:
        plot_gradient_heatmap(all_data, args.output_dir, args.dpi, pfx)

    if "cosine" in figures and all_data:
        plot_cosine_similarity(all_data, args.output_dir, args.dpi, pfx)

    if "variance" in figures:
        if args.car_variance:
            plot_car_variance(
                args.car_variance, args.output_dir, args.dpi, pfx)
        else:
            print("Skipping variance figure (no --car_variance provided)")

    print("Done.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    ("full_occ_ln_v2", {"color": "#0072B2", "label": "Full OCC LN", "marker": "o", "ls": "-"}),

    ("detach_ln_v2",   {"color": "#D55E00", "label": "Detach LN",   "marker": "s", "ls": "--"}),

    ("featurizer",       {"name": "DINOv2", "n_blocks": 23}),
    ("fused_featurizer", {"name": "SigLIP", "n_blocks": 26}),

# Argument parsing
# ====================================================================

def parse_args():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="V2 gradient analysis paper figures for OccSafe-VLA",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--data", nargs="+", metavar="NAME:PATH",
        help="Gradient data files as NAME:PATH pairs "
             "(e.g., vanilla_v2:results/vanilla.pt)",
    )

        "--cosine_data", nargs="+", metavar="NAME:PATH", default=None,
        help="Separate cosine similarity files if not in --data files",

        "--output_dir", type=str, required=True,
        help="Output directory for PDF/PNG figures",
    )
    p.add_argument("--dpi", type=int, default=300)

        "--figures", nargs="+", default=None,
        choices=["heatmap", "cosine", "variance", "all"],
        help="Which figures to generate (default: all available)",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--prefix", type=str, default="v2",
        help="Output filename prefix (default: v2)",

# Data loading / normalization
# ====================================================================

def _norm_grad(stats):
    """Normalize gradient stat entry to {mean, std, values}."""
    return {
        "mean": stats.get("grad_norm_mean",
                          stats.get("action_grad_norm_mean", 0)),
        "std":  stats.get("grad_norm_std",
                          stats.get("action_grad_norm_std", 0)),
        "values": stats.get("grad_norms",
                            stats.get("values", [])),
    }


def _norm_cos(stats):
    """Normalize cosine stat entry to {mean, std, conflict_rate}."""
    return {
        "mean": stats.get("cosine_mean",
                          stats.get("cosine_sim_mean")),
        "std":  stats.get("cosine_std",
                          stats.get("cosine_sim_std", 0)),
        "conflict_rate": stats.get("conflict_rate"),
    }


def load_data(path_str):
    """Load gradient/cosine data from .pt or .json, normalize to:
      {'gradient': {layer: {...}}, 'cosine': {layer: {...}}}
    """
    path = Path(path_str)
    if path.suffix == ".pt":
        raw = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    elif path.suffix == ".json":
        with open(path) as f:
            raw = json.load(f)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported file format: {path.suffix}")

    gradient, cosine = {}, {}

    # Format A: structured {'gradient_stats': ..., 'cosine_stats': ...}
    if "gradient_stats" in raw:
        for layer, s in raw["gradient_stats"].items():
            gradient[layer] = _norm_grad(s)
        for layer, s in (raw.get("cosine_stats") or {}).items():
            cosine[layer] = _norm_cos(s)

    # Format B: same_seed JSON {'per_layer': {layer: {...}}}
    elif "per_layer" in raw:
        for layer, s in raw["per_layer"].items():
            gradient[layer] = _norm_grad(s)
            cos_mean = s.get("cosine_sim_mean", s.get("cosine_mean"))
            if cos_mean is not None:
                cosine[layer] = _norm_cos(s)

    else:

                cosine[layer] = _norm_cos(s)

def extract_encoder_blocks(per_layer, prefix):
    """Extract blocks for encoder prefix, deduplicated and sorted by index."""
    seen = {}
    for layer_name, stats in per_layer.items():
        if layer_name.startswith(f"{prefix}.blocks."):
            idx = int(layer_name.split(".")[2])
            if idx not in seen:
                seen[idx] = stats
    return sorted(seen.items())


def get_style(cond):
    """Look up plotting style; falls back to grey if unknown."""
    if cond in CONDITION_STYLES:
        return CONDITION_STYLES[cond]
    base = cond.replace("_v2", "")
    for k, v in CONDITION_STYLES.items():
        if k.replace("_v2", "") == base:
            return v
    return {"color": "#888888", "label": cond, "marker": ".", "ls": "-"}

def plot_gradient_heatmap(all_data, output_dir, dpi, prefix):
    """Two-panel heatmap (DINOv2 + SigLIP): conditions × layers, log scale."""
    cond_order = [c for c in CONDITION_STYLES if c in all_data]
    if not cond_order:
        cond_order = list(all_data.keys())
    if not cond_order:
        print("No gradient data for heatmap, skipping")
        return

    enc_list = list(ENCODERS.items())
    matrices = []
    for enc_key, enc_info in enc_list:
        n_b = enc_info["n_blocks"]
        mat = np.full((len(cond_order), n_b), np.nan)
        for ci, cond in enumerate(cond_order):
            for idx, stats in extract_encoder_blocks(
                    all_data[cond]["gradient"], enc_key):
                if idx < n_b:
                    mat[ci, idx] = stats["mean"]
        matrices.append(mat)

    all_vals = np.concatenate([m[np.isfinite(m)] for m in matrices])
    if len(all_vals) == 0:
        print("No finite gradient values for heatmap, skipping")
        return

    norm = mcolors.LogNorm(vmin=max(all_vals.min(), 1e-6), vmax=all_vals.max())

    cmap.set_bad(color="#f0f0f0")

    width_ratios = [ENCODERS[e]["n_blocks"] for e in ENCODERS]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1, len(enc_list),
        figsize=(7.5, 0.45 * len(cond_order) + 0.8),
        gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": width_ratios, "wspace": 0.06},
        sharey=True,
    )
    if len(enc_list) == 1:
        axes = [axes]

    cond_labels = [get_style(c)["label"] for c in cond_order]
    im = None

    for i, ((enc_key, enc_info), mat) in enumerate(zip(enc_list, matrices)):

        im = ax.imshow(mat, aspect="auto", cmap=cmap, norm=norm,
                        interpolation="nearest")

        n_b = enc_info["n_blocks"]
        xticks = list(range(0, n_b, 5))
        if n_b - 1 not in xticks:
            xticks.append(n_b - 1)
        ax.set_xticks(xticks)
        ax.set_xticklabels([str(t) for t in xticks])

        if i == 0:
            ax.set_yticks(range(len(cond_labels)))
            ax.set_yticklabels(cond_labels)
        else:
            ax.yaxis.set_tick_params(labelleft=False)

        sub = chr(ord("a") + i)
        ax.set_xlabel(f"{enc_info['name']} block index")
        ax.set_title(f"({sub}) {enc_info['name']}", fontsize=10, pad=6)

        for spine in ax.spines.values():
            spine.set_visible(False)

    fig.colorbar(
        im, ax=axes, location="right", fraction=0.02, pad=0.02,
        label="Gradient norm (log scale)",
    )

    _save(fig, output_dir, f"{prefix}_grad_heatmap", dpi)


# ====================================================================
# Figure 2: Cosine Similarity Curves
# ====================================================================

    """Two-panel line plot: cosine similarity per layer with shaded std."""

    if not conds:
        conds = [c for c in all_data if all_data[c]["cosine"]]
    if not conds:
        print("No cosine similarity data, skipping")
        return

    enc_list = list(ENCODERS.items())
    width_ratios = [ENCODERS[e]["n_blocks"] for e in ENCODERS]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1, len(enc_list),
        figsize=(7.2, 2.8),
        gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": width_ratios, "wspace": 0.14},

    if len(enc_list) == 1:
        axes = [axes]

    for i, (enc_key, enc_info) in enumerate(enc_list):
        ax = axes[i]
        for cond in conds:
            style = get_style(cond)
            blocks = extract_encoder_blocks(all_data[cond]["cosine"], enc_key)
            if not blocks:
                continue
            xs = np.array([b[0] for b in blocks])
            ys = np.array([b[1]["mean"] for b in blocks], dtype=float)
            stds = np.array([b[1].get("std", 0) or 0 for b in blocks],
                            dtype=float)

            ax.plot(xs, ys, color=style["color"], label=style["label"],
                    marker=style["marker"], markersize=3, linewidth=1.4,
                    ls=style["ls"], alpha=0.85, markeredgewidth=0)
            ax.fill_between(xs, ys - stds, ys + stds,
                            alpha=0.12, color=style["color"])

        ax.axhline(0, color="#888888", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.7,
                    alpha=0.5, zorder=1)

        ax.set_xlim(-0.5, enc_info["n_blocks"] - 0.5)
        ax.set_xticks(range(0, enc_info["n_blocks"], 5))
        ax.set_xlabel(f"{enc_info['name']} block index")

            ax.set_ylabel("Cosine similarity")
        else:
            ax.yaxis.set_tick_params(labelleft=False)

        sub = chr(ord("a") + i)
        ax.set_title(f"({sub}) {enc_info['name']}", fontsize=10, pad=6)

        ax.grid(True, alpha=0.15, axis="y")
